I’ve been up since 4AM because I needed to write a grant proposal for a climate crisis artist project before teaching+parenting. I’m tired, but @NaomiAKlein said it best: “fuck work/life balance.” This is a #climateemergency. I’m committing to start governing myself accordingly. https://t.co/86uCqg84yR

I’m 3,000 miles away crying at my daughter’s swimming lesson, because it’s so powerful to know people are demanding that #HarvardYale divest. I never went to #TheGame in all my 4 years at #Harvard, but that’s because no one ever disrupted it for #PuertoRico or #ClimateEmergency

A big piece of this swing to the left is really about the #ClimateCrisis. We don't have time for lesser of 2 evils. Because if we need a #GreenNewDeal candidate who fundamentally challenges the fossil fuel industry+makes huge changes starting in 2021. So it's time to go all in.
#ClimateEmergency

@sunrisemvmt @sunrisebayarea It was pretty last minute before being out all last week for the holiday. Today at the school I invited kids to a Climate Club. I expected my kid+a few friends.

40 KIDS SHOWED UP!
3rd+4th graders w/ facts on the #ClimateCrisis.

One girl arrived w/ her fist already in the air. https://t.co/q4zfDcBJqT

I swear these moderates are trying to kill us. Either by Tr*mp’s 2nd term b/c #NeverBiden fails to inspire voters, or—if elected—by Biden’s inaction on #climatecrisis that leads to 🌎🔥. Only way fwd is #ProgressiveDem2020. @ewarren or @SenSanders. OUR WAY OF LIFE NEEDS TO CHANGE

@ewarren @SenSanders Impeaching Tr*mp is the best thing to come out of Washington in the last 4 years. The other great things have been the rise of the @sunrisemvmt @Y_Vs_A @GretaThunberg #MeToo+all the resistance movements. Not to mention @ewarren+@SenSanders as Dem candidates pushing to the left.

@NaomiAKlein I was concerned about #ClimateChange, but it had to stand in line behind all the other political issues on my radar (racism/sexism). I didn't see it as a bigger existential threat, or as a problem whose solutions could actually solve many of the other political ills on my radar.

@NaomiAKlein So some folks had already pushed me to begin to look at the #climatecrisis by the time #HurricaneMaria hit. This was when my heart broke open. I was enraged+grief-stricken, horrified+filled with guilt, as were so many other Diaspora #PuertoRicans. I couldn't look away any longer.

@NaomiAKlein So I turned to my peer counseling community w/ grief+rage about Puerto Rico+terror about the #ClimateCrisis+feelings that I wasn't enough or wasn't the right person to take a public role in the climate movement. I made the decision, took action+had to walk through the feelings.

@NaomiAKlein It was the first novel published about #HurricaneMaria+I billed it as being about #colonization+#ClimateChange. The series has broad appeal but is marketed heavily to low-income black+brown young women. The heroine is in that demographic+it's about her journey to climate activism

@ClimateKids2 @emahlee The environmental movement has historically been middle/upper class white people. But the environmental justice movement is not, nor is #BlackLivesMatter or the movements of houseless folks, tenant's rights or grassroots worker's movements, Harm Reduction or #SexWorkers activism.

@NaomiAKlein @sunrisemvmt @Y_Vs_A @MDeMocker @afrocomiccon Wanna add this to my #HowICameToClimate thread: My heritage is African American, Puerto Rican+West Indian. My island folks particularly Ricans don't need help understanding that the #ClimateCrisis affects us. PR recently identified as the nation most affected by #ClimateChange.

@StevePtweets @IanHaneyLopez But #ClimateChange means we don't have time for gradual solutions. We need to elect a #ProgressiveDem2020 who will tackle corruption+fight to pass a #GreenNewDeal because we don't have time for a gradual solution. These next four years are our window to save the planet. Period.
Two chapters later @MDeMocker’s book has a part about feeling your feelings about the #ClimateCrisis.

.@sunrisemvmt has given me hope that we can stop the #ClimateCrisis and win a #GreenNewDeal. Not only did I become active in the climate movement, but I became a monthly donor to them (& to Sanders+Warren) #ProgressiveDem2020 #RegimeChange #ClimateJustice https://t.co/whCHHO9nfp

@hackermoms @SFWC @KensingtonBooks The process of responding to the hurricane+writing the novel also awakened ME about #climatecrisis. In 2018, I made the internal shift to become a climate activist. It's now on top of my list to integrate into my parenting, teaching+writing. Everything else depends on this fight.
